items.title: Merck KGaA to buy Bio-Techne for $11.3bn in life science footprint expansion
items.summary: The deal is Merck’s largest since 2015, when it spent $17bn on acquiring Sigma-Aldrich, also a life sciences specialist.

items.title: N. America job signals: What leaders need to know about the healthtech hiring squeeze
items.summary: Active job postings in healthtech have fallen consistently, with a decline of more than 40%. This is not seasonal noise.

items.title: MSD’s Keytruda-Padcev combo secures EC approval for MIBC
items.summary: The EC has approved MSD's Keytruda in combination with Padcev as a neoadjuvant treatment for muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC).

items.title: BIO 2026: Indiana, biopharma investment and the Lilly effect
items.summary: BioCrossroads' Vince Wong discusses how his state is looking to differentiate itself from its rivals.

items.title: RQ Bio secures $115m to develop influenza antibody programme
items.summary: RQ Bio has closed a $115m Series A funding round to advance its long-acting antibody therapeutic programme RQB01, which targets influenza prevention in high-risk and immunocompromised groups.
